citation.title: Enhanced fast ion prompt loss due to resonant magnetic perturbations in KSTAR
citation.authors: Kim, Kimin; Jhang, Hogun; Kim, Junghee; Rhee, T.

topic: Full-orbit simulation of RMP-induced fast-ion prompt loss in KSTAR, compared qualitatively with FILD observations
own_question: How do RMP amplitude and plasma-response modeling (vacuum vs ideal IPEC) affect fast-ion loss, and what explains an observed threshold?
actual_method_and_evidence: POCA full-orbit tracking of 20,000 NuBDeC-deposited beam ions without collisions, run in vacuum and ideal-response perturbed equilibria. FILD measurements from two KSTAR H-mode discharges were used. The authors report a loss threshold near dB/dB0 about 4 with the ideal response, versus small losses with the vacuum field. The experimental saturation was not reproduced. CES ion temperature appears only as a time trace; there is no CES, BES/ECEI or nowcasting analysis.
input_target_timing_if_relevant: Not relevant; no causal estimation, report timing or 10 ms computation.
validation_if_relevant: Qualitative simulation-experiment comparison only; no held-out validation.
forbidden_inferences: Do not cite as evidence on CES Ti nowcasting, BES/ECEI information or pedestal-top chord behavior.
Do not imply KSTAR2022 relevance; this paper uses earlier discharges.
Do not treat the ideal-response threshold as established physics.
Do not cite as evidence of real-time capability.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: The paper concerns fast-ion orbit loss under RMPs. Its only overlap with our paper is the KSTAR device and a routine Ti time trace, so it gives no support to our framing.
source_scope_note: All extracted page texts supplied; figure/equation visual validation remains separate
